Name: Clint Sells Bar
Author: tpgml
Description:
[size=4]Clint sells Copper,Iron,Gold,Iridium Bar.
This simple mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url]﻿ and also uses the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿ to tell the player when Clint has upgraded her store.
The Mail Framework Mod is not required, but is definitely recommended for optimal experience.

As stated above, he shop grows as you become better friends.
Below is a list of he new items and how many hearts needed for them:
- Copper Bar(2 Hearts)
- Iron Bar(4 Hearts)
- Gold Bar(6 Hearts)
- Iridium Bar(10 Hearts)

You could technically modify it relatively easily. Just open the "shops.json" and change the value.

Insert the [STF] Clint Sells Bar, [MFM]Clint Sells Bar into the Mods folder.

1.0.1-correction of typos[/size]
